coverage_notes.text: Zoning map amendments, Planned Developments, special uses and administrative adjustments require notice to the alderman of the ward (§17-13-0100, §17-13-0300, §17-13-0600), and whether a project is approved turns on discretionary approvals this page cannot assess. Ward 27: Ald. Burnett, Walter R., (312) 432-1995.
The City's zoning map can lag a passed amendment by up to 90 days.
The Municipal Code text used here is current through 2026-03-18; a later Council amendment may not be reflected.

This page is a screening tool, not a zoning determination. The City's Zoning Verification Letter confirms a parcel's zoning ($150, up to 30 days, as published by the Office of the Zoning Administrator, checked 2026-09-30); a letter of opinion covers a specific project.

unit_yield.arithmetic: 3,435 sq ft ÷ 200 sq ft per unit = 17.2 → 17 units
unit_yield.basis: Minimum lot area per dwelling unit for the district
unit_yield.caveat: Lot area per unit only: FAR, height, parking and other standards can allow fewer units, and exemptions (efficiency/SRO units, ground-floor Type A units) can allow more.
unit_yield.lot_area_note: Efficiency and SRO units count at smaller areas than a dwelling unit (see the density table).

tod_benefits.note: Transit-served: minimum parking can be reduced by up to 100% (17-10-0102-B). No density, FAR or height bonus at C2-5: those apply only in dash-3 districts (17-3-0402-B, 17-3-0403-B, 17-3-0408-B (B/C districts); 17-4 (D districts)).
